title.zh: Claude 商业化的四种路径
Team Standard / Premium：5 小时窗口 Token 量估算
title.en: Team Standard / Premium: Estimated Tokens per 5-Hour Window

subtitle.zh: 订阅同时受窗口与周额度约束；下面把额度折算成单个 5 小时窗口的 Token 量。
subtitle.en: Window and weekly limits both apply; below, each allowance is converted into tokens per 5-hour window.

translations.窗口与周额度以 API 等价值表示: Window and weekly limits shown as API-equivalent value
translations.单窗口模型构成 · 按 API 价值: Model mix per window · by API value
translations.额度主要消耗在 Opus；占比为 API 价值口径。: Most of the allowance is spent on Opus; shares are by API value.
translations.假设：Claude Code 日常编码场景下的 Token 构成比例: Assumption: token mix in a normal Claude Code coding session
translations.报告。Token 构成与换算为建模假设（沿用报告混合模型），Premium 由: report. Token mix and conversion are modeled (following the report’s blend); Premium derived at 4.8×.

title.zh: 3,620 万 Tokens 难支撑高强度开发，5 小时额度容易提前触顶
title.en: 36.2M Tokens Can't Sustain High-Intensity Work; 5-Hour Limits Hit Early

subtitle.zh: Standard 场景估算：单个 5 小时窗口，不代表可以连续开发满 5 小时。
subtitle.en: Standard scenarios: a 5-hour window does not guarantee 5 hours of continuous coding.

translations.2–3 小时可能触顶（估）: May hit the limit in 2–3 hours (est.)
translations.触顶时，功能开发或测试修复仍可能继续。: Feature work or test fixes may still remain.

title.zh: GLM-5.3 降本 60%–70%，切入高强度 Coding 增量需求
title.en: GLM-5.3: 60–70% Cost Reduction for High-Intensity Coding

subtitle.zh: 结合前后端开发实践与华为 GLM-5.3 当前产品能力，优先试点额度触顶后的可迁移任务。
subtitle.en: Frontend/backend development practice and Huawei GLM-5.3’s current capabilities support pilots for tasks beyond subscription limits.

translations.优先寻找经常触顶的研发团队，承接跨模块开发、测试修复与多 Agent 并行任务。: Target teams hitting limits: cross-module work, test fixes and parallel agents.
translations.保留现有 Claude 订阅，用 GLM-5.3 按量 API 试点可迁移任务。: Keep the Claude subscription; pilot migratable tasks on the GLM-5.3 API, billed per token.
translations.MaaS 仍有 TPM、RPM 与服务配额限制。: MaaS TPM, RPM and service quotas still apply.
translations.同等任务，成本降低: Lower cost on the same tasks
OpenSpec-guided frontend work and TypeScript / Node.js backend work, with code review.
translations.同等开发任务，费用约为原来的 3–4 折: Same tasks: about 30–40% of the original cost
translations.缓存读取全部命中 · 理论费用: All cache reads hit · modeled cost
translations.Opus API 折算 $20.17 · 同量同配比: Opus API equivalent: $20.17 · same volume and mix
translations.华为 GLM-5.3 · 当前缓存命中率 97%: Huawei GLM-5.3 · current cache hit rate: 97%
translations.从额度触顶找到需求，用降本案例吸引试用，再以同任务 POC 验证成功率与总成本。: Find demand at quota limits, use the savings case to invite trials, then validate success and cost on the same tasks.
